code.execution.ssh-keys.label: SSH keys
code.execution.ssh-keys.help: Keys Puppet Master signs in with: a name, the type, and where the private half is kept. Only the public half is ever read.

code.execution.server-sign-in.help: Paired with a setup code, or an SSH key from your list. A password used once to place a key is never kept.
